PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Authenticated player profile, currency balance, XP/Level progression, achievements, selected vehicle, and career telemetry.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: Driver callsign or Google display name (1-50 chars).

credits.description: In-game racing cash earned from races, achievements, and drift sessions.

level.description: Current player level derived from XP (1-50).

selectedCarId.description: Currently active vehicle ID in the garage and city.

totalDistanceKm.description: Cumulative kilometers driven in the open world.

highestDriftCombo.description: Highest single drift combo score achieved.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each update.

GarageCar.title: GarageCar
GarageCar.description: An owned vehicle with 6 visual customization systems and 6 mechanical upgrade tracks.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

carId.description: Vehicle catalog identifier matching the document ID.

paintHex.description: Hex color for metallic chassis paint (e.g. #E50914).

underglowHex.description: Hex color for neon underglow or NONE.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at unlock.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on customization.

CareerProgress.title: CareerProgress
CareerProgress.description: Personal best record and medal standing for a specific Career street event.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

eventId.description: Career event identifier matching the document ID.

bestTimeMs.description: Best completion time in milliseconds (0 if not yet timed).

bestDriftScore.description: Highest drift score recorded for this event.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on first completion.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on record update.

/users/{userId}.description: Root player profile, XP/Levels, achievements, and progression stats scoped to authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/garageCars/{carId}.description: Owned vehicles, 6 visual customizations, and 6 upgrade tracks scoped to authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/careerProgress/{eventId}.description: Career race, time trial, and drift event records scoped to authenticated user.
